subject: Building Construction
examFormat: Three papers, all compulsory; Papers 1 and 2 are taken at one sitting. Paper 1: forty multiple-choice questions in 45 minutes for 40 marks. Paper 2: five short-structured essay questions, answer any four, in 1 hour for 60 marks. Paper 3: practical test of 2 1/2 hours for 100 marks; for Nigeria, Sierra Leone and The Gambia it is on Building Drawing, with four questions of which the compulsory one and any two others are answered.
excluded: Paper 3 Section B (Ghana only, six essay questions) is not described in the examination format; the detailed syllabus has no country split, so all 24 content topics are included.

topics.name: Introduction to Building
objectives: Define building
Classify buildings and state their types
Describe the National Building Codes (building regulations and byelaw requirements)

topics.name: Building Construction and Construction Team
objectives: Define building construction and state its purpose and procedures
Identify the parties in the construction team (client's team, contractor's team and statutory personnel)
State the functions of the team members
Explain the relationship of the parties

topics.name: Safety Practices
objectives: Define safety, rules and regulations
Identify hazards in the workshop and on the construction site
State the causes and methods of accident prevention
Identify safety equipment and measures at the construction site
Identify first aid equipment, procedures and safety wears
Observe safety in working with dangerous equipment and materials (electricity, scaffolding, formwork, cement, roof, etc.)

topics.name: Basic Tools, Equipment and Machines
objectives: Identify basic tools, equipment and machines and state their functions
Care for tools and equipment

topics.name: Site Clearing and Levelling
objectives: Describe the operations involved in site clearing
Identify tools and equipment for site clearing and levelling
Describe basic site levelling operations

topics.name: Site Organization and Layout
objectives: Describe preliminary operations in building construction
Describe the procedure for site layout
Locate boundary lines, hoarding, hutments and access road

topics.name: Setting Out
objectives: Describe methods of setting out (3:4:5 method, builders' square method)
Identify tools and equipment for setting out
Describe the procedures for setting out

topics.name: Building Drawing
objectives: Use drawing tools and do simple exercises on plane geometry in relation to building
Use building drawing symbols
Use scales in building and apply them on site
Interpret production drawings (plans, elevations, sections and details)
Draw special details (detailing building elements including doors and windows schedule)
Scale drawings (enlargement, pictorial and perspectives)
Define and state the use of Auto-CADD

topics.name: Excavation and Earth-work
objectives: Classify soils and state their types and properties
Define excavation and state its function
Describe methods of excavation
Identify tools, equipment and plant used for excavation
Solve excavation problems (earthwork support, timbering, battering and dewatering)
Observe safety rules during excavations

topics.name: Foundation
objectives: Define foundation and state its purpose and functional requirement
Identify the types of foundation
State the factors that determine choice of foundation

topics.name: Ground Floors
objectives: State the types, functions and functional requirement of ground floors
Describe methods of constructing ground floors
Define basement
Explain the differences between buildings with and without basement
State problems relating to basements in a building

topics.name: Suspended Floors
objectives: Define upper floor and state its functions
Describe methods of constructing concrete floors and timber upper floors

topics.name: Concrete
objectives: Define concrete and state its types
Identify materials for concrete
Define cement and state its types, components, manufacture, properties and uses, including alternatives such as Pozzolana, Pulverized Fuel Ash (P.F.A.) and Rice Husk Ash (R.H.A.)
State the types and uses of aggregates (including palm kernel shell and periwinkle shell)
State the types and uses of reinforcements
Describe the properties and characteristics of concrete
Describe the process of concrete production
Identify the types of concrete tests

topics.name: Walls
objectives: Define walls and state their types and functions
Define walling materials and state their types and properties (including locally sourced materials)
Describe the manufacturing processes of walling materials (clay, brick, blocks and concrete blocks)
State the sizes of blocks and bricks
Prepare mortar mixes for brick
Describe methods of wall construction and timber wall construction
Define wall openings and state their function
Describe methods of constructing wall openings
State the functions of lintels and arches

topics.name: Doors and Windows
objectives: Define doors and windows and state their functions and types
Describe methods of fixing door and window frames

topics.name: Staircases
objectives: Define stairs and state their classification, types and uses
Identify materials used for construction of stairs
Identify materials used for finishing staircases

topics.name: Plumbing Installations and Drainage System
objectives: Identify the types of fitting in plumbing and sanitary works
Identify materials for plumbing works and fittings
Identify the types of sanitary appliances
Identify soil and waste appliances
Describe installation of sanitary appliances
Define terms used in drainage works
State the principles and functional requirement of drainage systems
Identify the types of drainage system
Identify the types of drainage materials (pipes and fittings)
Describe methods of laying and testing drain lines
Describe septic and soakaway (inspection chamber, manhole, etc.)

topics.name: Electrical Installation and Solar Energy System
objectives: Use electrical symbols, installation terms and materials
Identify electrical wiring materials and state their uses
Identify the types of electrical wiring
Define solar energy systems and state their functions and components

topics.name: Roofs
objectives: Define roof and state its purpose and types
State the functional requirements of roofs
Identify materials used for roofs
Identify roof covering materials
Describe protection of roofs from wind, rain, lightning, etc.

subtopics.name: Floor finishes
objectives: State the types and characteristics of floor finishes
Describe methods of laying floor finishes
State the uses of floor finishes
Describe care and maintenance of floor finishes

subtopics.name: Wall finishes
objectives: State the types and characteristics of wall finishes
Describe plastering and rendering and the types of rendering
Describe methods of applying plastering and rendering mix

subtopics.name: Ceiling finishes
objectives: State the types and function of ceiling finishes
Identify ceiling finishing materials

topics.name: External Work
objectives: Identify the types of fence and materials for fencing, and describe construction of fence
Identify the types of gate, and describe fixing and production of gates
Identify the types of and materials for construction of access roads
Describe construction of access road
State the needs and materials for landscaping
Describe the procedures for landscaping

topics.name: Types of Business Organization and Ways of Raising Capital
objectives: State the principles and management of business organization in the building industry
Identify the types of business organization in the building industry
Identify the types and sources of capital

topics.name: Book Keeping
objectives: Describe book keeping in small scale businesses
Identify books of original entries

topics.name: Contract Work
objectives: Define contract and state its types
Identify contract documents
Identify the parties to a contract
